metadata.description: A portable Archon workflow that grooms a tracker ticket to ready-for-implementation

plugins.description: Take a tracker ticket from intake to ready-for-implementation — detect input, analyse across all configured repos and linked docs, classify Bug vs Change-Request/Story, rewrite to the configured template, PERT-estimate, and write back after a human approval gate. Tracker-agnostic (Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub), multi-repo, and OS-independent.
plugins.name: unic-ticket-specification
